verdict.rationale: Angular documents first-party unit testing via the CLI (`ng test`) and signals-based reactive state with dependency injection. Community reports describe it as testability-focused, with comprehensive test support. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly shows testing signals, services, or logic in isolation without rendering components to the DOM. missing for 10: documentation of DOM-free testing of signals/services, testing utilities or guide for reactive state, hands-on corroboration for modern Angular.
